notes: even introduces an appositive the Hebrew merely juxtaposes, with no waw and no object marker on the phrase it stands before, so it is added under rules 14 and 16; the lamed already holds its own to.
belongeth is the relational verb written where a copula would stand and joins the possessive lamed's unit under rule 49, headed on the written preposition.
Both headless relatives take a supplied antecedent him under rule 46, and both resumptive suffixes are unrepresented under rule 22.
